svg.title: The review pipeline
svg.desc: Engraved flow of one run of the pr-review-process skill, left to right in eight stations: prepare (diff, PR intent, REVIEW.md); classify the tier (classifier, then a second opinion); the security engine runs first and any BLOCK is final, reported and stopped; bug hunters in fresh context and in parallel (quick 1, standard 3, deep 5); verifiers vote and a finding is posted at 2 of 3 REAL (deep 3 of 3); filter (style dropped, nitCap 3, labels Important, Nit, Pre-existing); report (first line is the count, ends Round N of 3); a human decides, and agent approvals never count. Source: A. Osmani, M. W. Lunt and Q. Wang, “How the Claude Code team does code review”, Anthropic, 15 October 2026, https://claude.dev/blog/solving-code-review-at-anthropic/. Independent implementation, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
